C0938.title: JD Finance Assists Police in Dismantling 'Debt Optimization' Fraud Ring
C0938.summary: In December 2024, Legal Weekly reported that JD Finance assisted police in investigating an 'anti-collection' financial fraud case. A criminal gang operating under the guise of a consulting firm in Jiangxi used 'debt optimization' and 'proxy rights protection' as pretexts to defraud financial consumers of their assets and harvest personal information. Police apprehended seven suspects, and the case entered judicial processing.
